unverified.compression_ratio: CONFLICT. GM 1998 (p.50): 20.2:1 (turbo L65/L56). Wikipedia: GM early 21.3:1, GM late 20.3:1, marine 18.0:1. DieselHub: 18:1 to 21.5:1 by year and application.
unverified.firing_order: 1-8-7-2-6-5-4-3. GM 1998 kit p.50 and DieselHub agree. Wikipedia does not give it. Two sources; second-pass candidate.
unverified.RPO_note: The brief calls L49 a turbo. GM 1994 and 1995 kits, Wikipedia and DieselHub all say L49 = naturally aspirated (VIN P), light duty. L57 = naturally aspirated heavy-duty/HO (VIN Y, also military) per Wikipedia and DieselHub; no GM truck kit read lists L57.
